changelog: Live Caption Transcription Monitor: Real-time progress %, timecode, ETA, speed, word count, GPU/CPU badge, live transcript preview, and safe Cancel.
Seamless Inline Caption Editing: Click directly on the on-video caption box with focus border, Enter/click-outside auto-save, Esc cancel, and Saved badge.
Long-Video Stability Fix: Eliminated 3-minute UI freeze when editing captions on 2+ hour videos (<1ms latency) plus O(log N) playhead caption lookup.
Precision Caption Box Geometry: 4-slider Width/Height/Pos X/Pos Y controls with 2D auto-fit font sizing matching the visual bounds guide 1:1.
Dual Anti-Glare Studio Themes (Dark 5 & Light 1), Adaptive Inspector, Locked Fit/Contain Video Viewport, Interactive Timeline Scrollbar & 60K Waveform.
